attempts.actualText: View photo ↗ Film poster framing Art, prints & photographs From a new print to a picture ready for a different frame. Examples include graffiti art with a lilac insert, a Belgian limited edition print and an original film poster. Have a photo and approximate width and height to hand. Mention any existing frame you want to change. Ask about your artwork ↗ Explore all framing services, including canvas stretching, mount cutting, certificates and embroidery.

attempts.actualText: View photo ↗ Signed shirt framing Shirts & medals Keep the memories of a match, a season or a personal milestone on show. Past work includes Arsenal, Spurs and Millwall shirts, a Di Canio reframe, signed golf flags and Formula 1 memorabilia. Say which side of the shirt you want to see, and whether there are medals or other items to include. Discuss your memorabilia ↗

attempts.actualText: Useful measurements Width of your piece Your piece Height For objects, add depth ↗ Measure the piece, not the space on the wall. Approximate dimensions are a useful starting point. Start with what you have. You don't need to have chosen a frame to get in touch. A few details help start the conversation. A clear photograph Show the whole piece, and any detail that matters to you. An idea of size Width and height for flat pieces. Add depth for objects. What you have in mind A new frame, a different look, or something to match an existing piece. Talk it through with Paul ↓
